scenarios.name: the Class written: ONE query at the frame end; the rows become Items, Success
nothing written: no query, ever; Items undefined, Is Empty true, Count 0
Do with nothing written queries anyway — collection undefined
Class, Search, a filter and its parameter in one frame: one query carrying all of them
the same Class again does not re-query (DEF-046); Do does
the visual filter written again with the same value re-queries — no comparison on the panel's two editors
Use limit with no Limit or Skip: limit 10, skip 0; Limit 2 then narrows
Limit without Use limit is not sent
Fetch total count: the call asks for it, and the answer's total is re-sent on Total Count
a connected rule whose parameter has supplied nothing does not narrow the query
a filter the Parse lowering refuses (pointsTo, no schema): Error is the refusal, Failure, no call

trace.value: Filtering "owner" by the record it points to needs the collection schema, so that the related collection is known.

scenarios.name: a Backend the project does not have: the not-configured sentence, Failure, no call; Items stays unset

scenarios.name: the first failure publishes the empty array; a later one keeps the rows already shown
refused with no message: Error is `Failed to fetch.`
the Class box unticked: the Class is stored and nothing runs; Do queries with it
the Query settings box unticked: a Limit change does not re-query; Do does
a Do while a query is out is a second query; each answer publishes its own array
the visual sort: one '-'-prefixed name per rule, in order
the retired QueryEditor shape reads the same as the builder's: a rule on a parameter
an empty Search sends none; an empty filter group narrows nothing
an empty answer: Items is an empty array, Is Empty true, First Record Id unset, Success
the Backend picker names the second backend: the query goes there
a filter parameter's own box unticked: its change does not re-query
a write made elsewhere that matches the filter joins Items at the end (no sort); one that does not match, and one to another class, are not heard
under a sort a created record joins at its sorted place: before the first member that sorts after it
Limit under a DESCENDING sort: the record past the limit is dropped from the end — the new one when it sorts last
Limit under an ASCENDING sort drops the record that sorts LAST: a new record that sorts first stays and pushes the last out; one that sorts last is dropped again at once (v4, C40)
Limit with NO sort: a record that would go over the Limit asks the backend again — only it knows which records the Limit keeps (v4, C40)
a member saved out of the filter leaves Items; a record saved into it joins
a member whose sort key moved moves to its new place: a save that still matches re-sorts Items (v4, C41)
a delete removes a member; a delete of a record not shown changes nothing
with a Search term a write re-queries instead: one query at the next frame
the Record changes box unticked: a write made elsewhere is not heard
before the first answer a write is not heard — nothing is held yet; once the rows landed, the next one joins
a write to another backend's store is not heard: the node listens to the store of the backend it queried
the Class as it is NOW is matched: a Class changed with its box unticked hears the new class's writes into the old rows
after the first failure a write joins the empty array it published

slice C: Subscribe To Changes on with a Class — the query, then the subscribe `{ collection, primaryKey }` with NO filter though one is set; Realtime Status `connecting` at once (v2, D29 fixed), `subscribed` when the subscription says so
slice C: realtime written before the Class in one frame — the reconnect was scheduled first, so the subscribe is made before the query
slice C: a create told — Change Type, Changed Record, Changed Records, Changed Record Id; Record Created then Records Changed; the query runs again at the next frame end
slice C: Record changes unticked — a create is still told and pulsed, and nothing is queried again

slice C: init publishes the snapshot and pulses nothing, and re-queries nothing; an update pulses Record Updated; a key-only delete leaves Changed Record null and Changed Records empty with the id; resync pulses Records Changed alone
slice C: an error told — Realtime Error and Realtime Failure; a later subscribed clears the error; a fatal one stops the subscription

slice C: realtime on with no Class, then Do and the Class in a later frame — the reconnect asked for after the query this time, so the query is made first (a reconnect flag left set would put the subscribe first)
slice C: Subscribe To Changes then a Backend the project has not, in one frame — the reconnect fails first: Realtime Failure, then Failure
